objective: One Classic Normal desktop trial: multiple plausible first opponent replies and masked-policy continuation, compared with Context Teacher v1; no student fit.
reply_weight: 33 minus score gap; only the top three masked-policy replies within 32 points of the best; no hidden-outcome-dependent selection or weighting
design: For every legal root action and sampled world, branch the first opposing decision over plausible masked-policy replies; evaluate the remaining two plies with the same guarded-student policy and public event memory. Restore board, rules, strategic state, per-army RNG streams and public trajectory for each branch. Average by the declared reply weights. Apply the same response model to the existing wait reference. Keep full root context, source observer, eight samples, four-ply horizon and bounded correction blend unchanged.
development_gate: At least 52% head-to-head against Context Teacher v1, nonnegative matched league difference, more than 50% against production, and all protocol/privacy/state-restoration tests pass. Freeze before saved tournaments and do not tune settings on games.
validation_gate: Fresh paired 95% score interval against Context Teacher v1 entirely above 50%, fresh matched league block difference interval entirely above zero, and production score interval above 50%. No claim of reliable gain or subsequent student fit without these gates.
review: Reconstruct all 18 previously credited Scout-loss roots and their public opponent responses; use these only for diagnosis, never as strength games or private inputs.
limits: One desktop candidate design, no new model fit or X16 change. Preserve rejected as well as accepted evidence. A failed development gate ends the trial after the scheduled league; validation seeds remain unused.
